pokemon.name: Ekans
pokemon.flavor: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

pokemon.name: Arbok
pokemon.flavor: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

pokemon.name: Pikachu
pokemon.flavor: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

pokemon.name: Alolan Raichu
pokemon.flavor: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

pokemon.name: Raichu
pokemon.flavor: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

pokemon.name: Alolan Sandshrew
pokemon.flavor: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

pokemon.name: Sandshrew
pokemon.flavor: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

pokemon.name: Alolan Vulpix
pokemon.flavor: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

pokemon.name: Vulpix
pokemon.flavor: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

pokemon.name: Jigglypuff
pokemon.flavor: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

pokemon.name: Wigglytuff
pokemon.flavor: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

pokemon.name: Paras
pokemon.flavor: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

pokemon.name: Alolan Meowth
pokemon.flavor: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

pokemon.name: Galarian Meowth
pokemon.flavor: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

pokemon.name: Meowth
pokemon.flavor: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

pokemon.name: Alolan Persian
pokemon.flavor: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

pokemon.name: Persian
pokemon.flavor: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

pokemon.name: Psyduck
pokemon.flavor: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

pokemon.name: Golduck
pokemon.flavor: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

pokemon.name: Mankey
pokemon.flavor: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

pokemon.name: Primeape
pokemon.flavor: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

pokemon.name: Growlithe
pokemon.flavor: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

pokemon.name: Hisuian Growlithe
pokemon.flavor: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

pokemon.name: Poliwag
pokemon.flavor: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

evolutions.name: politoed
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Poliwhirl
pokemon.flavor: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

evolutions.name: politoed
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Bellsprout
pokemon.flavor: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.

pokemon.name: Weepinbell
pokemon.flavor: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

pokemon.name: Victreebel
pokemon.flavor: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

pokemon.name: Tentacool
pokemon.flavor: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.

pokemon.name: Tentacruel
pokemon.flavor: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

pokemon.name: Galarian Ponyta
pokemon.flavor: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

pokemon.name: Ponyta
pokemon.flavor: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

pokemon.name: Galarian Rapidash
pokemon.flavor: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.

pokemon.name: Rapidash
pokemon.flavor: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.

pokemon.name: Magnemite
pokemon.flavor: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

pokemon.name: Doduo
pokemon.flavor: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

pokemon.name: Dodrio
pokemon.flavor: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

pokemon.name: Seel
pokemon.flavor: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

pokemon.name: Alolan Grimer
pokemon.flavor: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

pokemon.name: Grimer
pokemon.flavor: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

pokemon.name: Alolan Muk
pokemon.flavor: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

pokemon.name: Muk
pokemon.flavor: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

pokemon.name: Shellder
pokemon.flavor: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

pokemon.name: Cloyster
pokemon.flavor: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

pokemon.name: Gastly
pokemon.flavor: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

evolutions.name: gengar
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Onix
pokemon.flavor: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.

evolutions.name: steelix
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Drowzee
pokemon.flavor: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

pokemon.name: Hisuian Voltorb
pokemon.flavor: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

pokemon.name: Voltorb
pokemon.flavor: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

pokemon.name: Hisuian Electrode
pokemon.flavor: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

pokemon.name: Cubone
pokemon.flavor: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

pokemon.name: Scyther
pokemon.flavor: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

evolutions.name: scizor
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Tauros
pokemon.flavor: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

pokemon.name: Tauros Aqua Breed
pokemon.flavor: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

pokemon.name: Tauros Blaze Breed
pokemon.flavor: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

pokemon.name: Tauros Combat Breed
pokemon.flavor: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

pokemon.name: Magikarp
pokemon.flavor: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

pokemon.name: Gyarados
pokemon.flavor: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

pokemon.name: Lapras
pokemon.flavor: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

pokemon.name: Eevee
pokemon.flavor: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

pokemon.name: Omanyte
pokemon.flavor: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

pokemon.name: Kabuto
pokemon.flavor: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

pokemon.name: Aerodactyl
pokemon.flavor: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

pokemon.name: Dratini
pokemon.flavor: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

pokemon.name: Dragonair
pokemon.flavor: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

pokemon.name: Chikorita
pokemon.flavor: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

pokemon.name: Cyndaquil
pokemon.flavor: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

pokemon.name: Totodile
pokemon.flavor: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.

pokemon.name: Hoothoot
pokemon.flavor: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.

pokemon.name: Noctowl
pokemon.flavor: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

pokemon.name: Spinarak
pokemon.flavor: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

pokemon.name: Ariados
pokemon.flavor: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

pokemon.name: Chinchou
pokemon.flavor: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

pokemon.name: Lanturn
pokemon.flavor: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”

pokemon.name: Pichu
pokemon.flavor: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

pokemon.name: Spiky-Eared Pichu
pokemon.flavor: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
pokemon.special: Complete the Port Pello sidequest by showing a Pikachu in your party.

pokemon.name: Igglybuff
pokemon.flavor: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

pokemon.name: Togepi
pokemon.flavor: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

pokemon.name: Togetic
pokemon.flavor: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.

pokemon.name: Natu
pokemon.flavor: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

pokemon.name: Xatu
pokemon.flavor: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

pokemon.name: Mareep
pokemon.flavor: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

pokemon.name: Flaaffy
pokemon.flavor: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

pokemon.name: Hoppip
pokemon.flavor: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

pokemon.name: Skiploom
pokemon.flavor: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

pokemon.name: Aipom
pokemon.flavor: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

pokemon.name: Yanma
pokemon.flavor: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

pokemon.name: Paldean Wooper
pokemon.flavor: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

pokemon.name: Wooper
pokemon.flavor: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

pokemon.name: Quagsire
pokemon.flavor: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

pokemon.name: Murkrow
pokemon.flavor: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

pokemon.name: Girafarig
pokemon.flavor: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.

pokemon.name: Gligar
pokemon.flavor: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.

pokemon.name: Heracross
pokemon.flavor: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

pokemon.name: Hisuian Sneasel
pokemon.flavor: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

pokemon.name: Sneasel
pokemon.flavor: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

pokemon.name: Swinub
pokemon.flavor: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.

pokemon.name: Corsola
pokemon.flavor: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

pokemon.name: Corsola Galarian
pokemon.flavor: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

pokemon.name: Galarian Corsola
pokemon.flavor: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

pokemon.name: Remoraid
pokemon.flavor: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the Remoraid is deep in the sea.

pokemon.name: Octillery
pokemon.flavor: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.

pokemon.name: Houndour
pokemon.flavor: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

pokemon.name: Houndoom
pokemon.flavor: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

pokemon.name: Phanpy
pokemon.flavor: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

pokemon.name: Stantler
pokemon.flavor: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

pokemon.name: Raikou
pokemon.flavor: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
pokemon.special: Interact with the Raikou statue in Sofos Acropolis Temple after Team Chimera’s defeat.

pokemon.name: Entei
pokemon.flavor: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
pokemon.special: Interact with the Entei statue in Sofos Acropolis Temple after Team Chimera’s defeat.

pokemon.name: Suicune
pokemon.flavor: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
pokemon.special: Interact with the Suicune statue in Sofos Acropolis Temple after Team Chimera’s defeat.

pokemon.name: Larvitar
pokemon.flavor: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

pokemon.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
pokemon.flavor: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

pokemon.name: Zigzagoon
pokemon.flavor: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

pokemon.name: Galarian Linoone
pokemon.flavor: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

pokemon.name: Linoone
pokemon.flavor: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

pokemon.name: Wurmple
pokemon.flavor: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

pokemon.name: Silcoon
pokemon.flavor: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

pokemon.name: Beautifly
pokemon.flavor: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

pokemon.name: Cascoon
pokemon.flavor: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

pokemon.name: Dustox
pokemon.flavor: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

pokemon.name: Wingull
pokemon.flavor: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

pokemon.name: Pelipper
pokemon.flavor: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

pokemon.name: Ralts
pokemon.flavor: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

pokemon.name: Kirlia
pokemon.flavor: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

pokemon.name: Shroomish
pokemon.flavor: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

pokemon.name: Breloom
pokemon.flavor: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

pokemon.name: Nincada
pokemon.flavor: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

pokemon.name: Ninjask
pokemon.flavor: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

pokemon.name: Shedinja
pokemon.flavor: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.

pokemon.name: Nosepass
pokemon.flavor: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

pokemon.name: Mawile
pokemon.flavor: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

pokemon.name: Aron
pokemon.flavor: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

pokemon.name: Meditite
pokemon.flavor: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

pokemon.name: Wailmer
pokemon.flavor: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

pokemon.name: Numel
pokemon.flavor: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

pokemon.name: Torkoal
pokemon.flavor: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

pokemon.name: Trapinch
pokemon.flavor: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

pokemon.name: Swablu
pokemon.flavor: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

pokemon.name: Altaria
pokemon.flavor: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

pokemon.name: Barboach
pokemon.flavor: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

pokemon.name: Whiscash
pokemon.flavor: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

pokemon.name: Corphish
pokemon.flavor: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

pokemon.name: Crawdaunt
pokemon.flavor: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

pokemon.name: Baltoy
pokemon.flavor: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

pokemon.name: Claydol
pokemon.flavor: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

pokemon.name: Lileep
pokemon.flavor: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

pokemon.name: Anorith
pokemon.flavor: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

pokemon.name: Kecleon
pokemon.flavor: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.

pokemon.name: Shuppet
pokemon.flavor: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

pokemon.name: Banette
pokemon.flavor: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

pokemon.name: Duskull
pokemon.flavor: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

evolutions.name: dusknoir
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Dusclops
pokemon.flavor: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

evolutions.name: dusknoir
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Tropius
pokemon.flavor: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

pokemon.name: Snorunt
pokemon.flavor: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

pokemon.name: Spheal
pokemon.flavor: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

pokemon.name: Sealeo
pokemon.flavor: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

pokemon.name: Clamperl
pokemon.flavor: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

evolutions.name: huntail
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

evolutions.name: gorebyss
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Huntail
pokemon.flavor: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

evolutions.name: huntail
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

evolutions.name: gorebyss
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Gorebyss
pokemon.flavor: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

evolutions.name: huntail
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

evolutions.name: gorebyss
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Relicanth
pokemon.flavor: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

pokemon.name: Pachirisu
pokemon.flavor: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

pokemon.name: Buizel
pokemon.flavor: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

pokemon.name: Floatzel
pokemon.flavor: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

pokemon.name: Cherubi
pokemon.flavor: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

pokemon.name: Cherrim
pokemon.flavor: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.

pokemon.name: Stunky
pokemon.flavor: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

pokemon.name: Skuntank
pokemon.flavor: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

pokemon.name: Bronzor
pokemon.flavor: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

pokemon.name: Chatot
pokemon.flavor: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

pokemon.name: Skorupi
pokemon.flavor: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

pokemon.name: Drapion
pokemon.flavor: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.

pokemon.name: Finneon
pokemon.flavor: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

pokemon.name: Lumineon
pokemon.flavor: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.

pokemon.name: Snover
pokemon.flavor: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

pokemon.name: Abomasnow
pokemon.flavor: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

pokemon.name: Yanmega
pokemon.flavor: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

pokemon.name: Lillipup
pokemon.flavor: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

pokemon.name: Pansage
pokemon.flavor: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

pokemon.name: Pansear
pokemon.flavor: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

pokemon.name: Panpour
pokemon.flavor: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

pokemon.name: Munna
pokemon.flavor: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

pokemon.name: Musharna
pokemon.flavor: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

pokemon.name: Blitzle
pokemon.flavor: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

pokemon.name: Woobat
pokemon.flavor: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

pokemon.name: Timburr
pokemon.flavor: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

evolutions.name: conkeldurr
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Gurdurr
pokemon.flavor: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

evolutions.name: conkeldurr
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Unovan Basculin
pokemon.flavor: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

pokemon.name: White-Striped Basculin
pokemon.flavor: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

pokemon.name: Sandile
pokemon.flavor: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

pokemon.name: Krokorok
pokemon.flavor: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

pokemon.name: Dwebble
pokemon.flavor: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

pokemon.name: Scraggy
pokemon.flavor: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

pokemon.name: Scrafty
pokemon.flavor: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

pokemon.name: Tirtouga
pokemon.flavor: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

pokemon.name: Archen
pokemon.flavor: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

pokemon.name: Zorua
pokemon.flavor: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

pokemon.name: Zorua Hisuian
pokemon.flavor: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

pokemon.name: Gothita
pokemon.flavor: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

pokemon.name: Gothorita
pokemon.flavor: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

pokemon.name: Gothitelle
pokemon.flavor: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

pokemon.name: Solosis
pokemon.flavor: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

pokemon.name: Duosion
pokemon.flavor: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

pokemon.name: Reuniclus
pokemon.flavor: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

pokemon.name: Ducklett
pokemon.flavor: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

pokemon.name: Swanna
pokemon.flavor: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

pokemon.name: Litwick
pokemon.flavor: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

pokemon.name: Lampent
pokemon.flavor: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

pokemon.name: Cubchoo
pokemon.flavor: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

pokemon.name: Mienfoo
pokemon.flavor: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

pokemon.name: Rufflet
pokemon.flavor: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

pokemon.name: Braviary
pokemon.flavor: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

pokemon.name: Hisuian Braviary
pokemon.flavor: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

pokemon.name: Vullaby
pokemon.flavor: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

pokemon.name: Chespin
pokemon.flavor: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

pokemon.name: Fennekin
pokemon.flavor: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

pokemon.name: Froakie
pokemon.flavor: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

pokemon.name: Litleo
pokemon.flavor: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

pokemon.name: Pyroar F
pokemon.flavor: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

pokemon.name: Pyroar M
pokemon.flavor: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

pokemon.name: Flabebe Blue Flower
pokemon.flavor: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

pokemon.name: Flabebe Orange Flower
pokemon.flavor: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

pokemon.name: Flabebe Red Flower
pokemon.flavor: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

pokemon.name: Flabebe White Flower
pokemon.flavor: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

pokemon.name: Flabebe Yellow Flower
pokemon.flavor: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

pokemon.name: Eternal Flower Floette
pokemon.flavor: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
pokemon.special: Complete the Péntepetal City sidequest using 12 Wishing Stars.

pokemon.name: Floette
pokemon.flavor: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

pokemon.name: Floette Blue Flower
pokemon.flavor: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

pokemon.name: Floette Red Flower
pokemon.flavor: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

pokemon.name: Floette Yellow Flower
pokemon.flavor: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

pokemon.name: Florges
pokemon.flavor: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

pokemon.name: Skiddo
pokemon.flavor: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

pokemon.name: Gogoat
pokemon.flavor: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

pokemon.name: Pancham
pokemon.flavor: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

pokemon.name: Honedge
pokemon.flavor: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

pokemon.name: Doublade
pokemon.flavor: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

pokemon.name: Skrelp
pokemon.flavor: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

pokemon.name: Clauncher
pokemon.flavor: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

pokemon.name: Clawitzer
pokemon.flavor: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

pokemon.name: Helioptile
pokemon.flavor: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

pokemon.name: Tyrunt
pokemon.flavor: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

pokemon.name: Amaura
pokemon.flavor: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

pokemon.name: Hawlucha
pokemon.flavor: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

pokemon.name: Dedenne
pokemon.flavor: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

pokemon.name: Goomy
pokemon.flavor: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

pokemon.name: Hisuian Sligoo
pokemon.flavor: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

pokemon.name: Sligoo
pokemon.flavor: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

pokemon.name: Pumpkaboo
pokemon.flavor: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

evolutions.name: gourgeist
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Gourgeist
pokemon.flavor: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

evolutions.name: gourgeist
evolutions.note: Lazarus: trade evolutions use the Linking Cord (Sofos City, Green Shard Exchange) instead of a trade.

pokemon.name: Rowlet
pokemon.flavor: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

pokemon.name: Litten
pokemon.flavor: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

pokemon.name: Popplio
pokemon.flavor: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

pokemon.name: Pikipek
pokemon.flavor: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

pokemon.name: Trumbeak
pokemon.flavor: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

pokemon.name: Toucannon
pokemon.flavor: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

pokemon.name: Grubbin
pokemon.flavor: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

pokemon.name: Charjabug
pokemon.flavor: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

pokemon.name: Crabrawler
pokemon.flavor: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

pokemon.name: Crabominable
pokemon.flavor: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

pokemon.name: Oricorio Baile
pokemon.flavor: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

pokemon.name: Oricorio Pa'u
pokemon.flavor: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

pokemon.name: Oricorio Pom-Pom
pokemon.flavor: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

pokemon.name: Oricorio Sensu
pokemon.flavor: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

pokemon.name: Cutiefly
pokemon.flavor: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

pokemon.name: Ribombee
pokemon.flavor: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

pokemon.name: Rockruff
pokemon.flavor: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

pokemon.name: Lycanroc Day
pokemon.flavor: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

pokemon.name: Lycanroc Night
pokemon.flavor: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

pokemon.name: Mudbray
pokemon.flavor: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

pokemon.name: Fomantis
pokemon.flavor: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

pokemon.name: Lurantis
pokemon.flavor: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

pokemon.name: Salandit
pokemon.flavor: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

pokemon.name: Stufful
pokemon.flavor: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

pokemon.name: Bewear
pokemon.flavor: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

pokemon.name: Bounsweet
pokemon.flavor: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

pokemon.name: Steenee
pokemon.flavor: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

pokemon.name: Comfey
pokemon.flavor: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

pokemon.name: Shiny Comfey
pokemon.flavor: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.
pokemon.special: Complete the Port Pello sidequest using 3 Strange Souvenirs.

pokemon.name: Oranguru
pokemon.flavor: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

pokemon.name: Passimian
pokemon.flavor: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

pokemon.name: Wimpod
pokemon.flavor: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

pokemon.name: Type: Null
pokemon.flavor: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.
pokemon.special: Complete the Fresco Isles sidequest using 12 Sitrus Berries.

pokemon.name: Minior Blue Core
pokemon.flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

pokemon.name: Minior Green Core
pokemon.flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

pokemon.name: Minior Indigo Core
pokemon.flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

pokemon.name: Minior Orange Core
pokemon.flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

pokemon.name: Minior Red Core
pokemon.flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

pokemon.name: Minior Violet Core
pokemon.flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

pokemon.name: Minior Yellow Core
pokemon.flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

pokemon.name: Komala
pokemon.flavor: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

pokemon.name: Togedemaru
pokemon.flavor: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

pokemon.name: Mimikyu
pokemon.flavor: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

pokemon.name: Bruxish
pokemon.flavor: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

pokemon.name: Dhelmise
pokemon.flavor: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

pokemon.name: Jangmo-o
pokemon.flavor: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

pokemon.name: Yamper
pokemon.flavor: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

pokemon.name: Boltund
pokemon.flavor: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

pokemon.name: Applin
pokemon.flavor: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

pokemon.name: Flapple
pokemon.flavor: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

pokemon.name: Appletun
pokemon.flavor: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

pokemon.name: Sizzlipede
pokemon.flavor: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

pokemon.name: Impidimp
pokemon.flavor: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

pokemon.name: Morgrem
pokemon.flavor: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

pokemon.name: Grimmsnarl
pokemon.flavor: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

pokemon.name: Obstagoon
pokemon.flavor: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

pokemon.name: Perrserker
pokemon.flavor: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

pokemon.name: Falinks
pokemon.flavor: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

pokemon.name: Snom
pokemon.flavor: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

pokemon.name: Cufant
pokemon.flavor: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

pokemon.name: Dreepy
pokemon.flavor: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

pokemon.name: Drakloak
pokemon.flavor: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

pokemon.name: Sprigatito
pokemon.flavor: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

pokemon.name: Fuecoco
pokemon.flavor: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

pokemon.name: Quaxly
pokemon.flavor: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

pokemon.name: Pawmi
pokemon.flavor: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

pokemon.name: Pawmo
pokemon.flavor: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

pokemon.name: Charcadet
pokemon.flavor: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

pokemon.name: Armarouge
pokemon.flavor: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

pokemon.name: Ceruledge
pokemon.flavor: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

pokemon.name: Wattrel
pokemon.flavor: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

pokemon.name: Kilowattrel
pokemon.flavor: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

pokemon.name: Shroodle
pokemon.flavor: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

pokemon.name: Grafaiai
pokemon.flavor: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

pokemon.name: Toedscool
pokemon.flavor: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

pokemon.name: Toedscruel
pokemon.flavor: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

pokemon.name: Klawf
pokemon.flavor: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

pokemon.name: Flittle
pokemon.flavor: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

pokemon.name: Espathra
pokemon.flavor: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

pokemon.name: Tinkatink
pokemon.flavor: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

pokemon.name: Tinkatuff
pokemon.flavor: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

pokemon.name: Finizen
pokemon.flavor: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

pokemon.name: Cyclizar
pokemon.flavor: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

pokemon.name: Annihilape
pokemon.flavor: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

pokemon.name: Clodsire
pokemon.flavor: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

pokemon.name: Farigiraf
pokemon.flavor: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

pokemon.name: Dipplin
pokemon.flavor: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

pokemon.name: Ogerpon
pokemon.flavor: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
pokemon.special: Complete all donations at the Kipos Town Zoo.

special.how: Complete the Port Pello sidequest by showing a Pikachu in your party.
